acceptance_criteria: GitHub Actions runs the Gradle test and clean build tasks with Java 25.
All compiler and automated test failures found by CI are fixed.
The workflow uploads the production JAR, test reports, source archive, and verification logs.
A headless development-client startup smoke test is attempted and its exact result is recorded.
The final report distinguishes verified behavior from anything that still requires manual in-game testing.
objective: Build and test SpeedBridge Assist 1.1.0 on Java 25 and Minecraft/Fabric 26.2 using GitHub Actions, fix real compile or test failures, smoke-test development client startup where possible, and publish verified artifacts and logs.
title: Verify SpeedBridge Assist 1.1.0
